answer_en: Section 46(1) of the Electoral Act, 2026, states that the Presiding Officer must open the empty ballot box or present the voting device before accreditation and voting begin. After that, the box is to be closed and sealed so no one else can open it. Section 46(2) also states that the ballot box must be placed in full view of all present and remain so until the poll closes. Therefore, the polling unit opens before accreditation and voting starts, and it closes and seals after that.
